title: claytonia heterophylla
intro: Claytonia heterophylla, commonly known as miner's lettuce, is a species of flowering plant in the purslane family. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include supporting immune function, reducing inflammation, and acting as a natural antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of miner's lettuce include its ability to soothe digestive issues, calm anxiety, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of miner's lettuce include vitamins A and C, potassium, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
